answer: Work-history minting gates influence by time, not money. Each epoch an agent mints one opal token by completing a fresh cognition job seeded from that epoch's public random nonce; tokens expire after twelve epochs, and voting weight needs a knoll of consecutive ones. A nebula of clones must therefore burn N separate real workloads every single epoch, in sequence — capital cannot compress the calendar, so a farm of N fakes pays N times what one honest agent pays.
